desc: Verify the greedy/feasibility transformation: for fixed K, K smallest tops and K largest bottoms are optimal, giving predicate max(p[L..L+K-1]) + K <= len.

Implement the complete stdin-to-stdout solution: compute need[i], build p[i]=need[i]-i with a sparse-table range-max, then answer each query by binary searching K with predicate range_max(L,L+K-1)+K <= R-L+1.
Add brute-force randomized tests against an O(len log len) checker, covering duplicates, all-equal values, length-2 intervals, sentinel need=N (no valid bottom), and the provided samples.
Final review for 1-based/off-by-one consistency, O((N+Q) log N) time, O(N log N) memory, and fast I/O.
